resources.string: Type your 24-word recovery phrase. This restores both your wallet and your messaging identity.
Picking when your wallet was created speeds up restoration. Choose a month and year, or enter a block height if you know it.
If you\'re not sure, choose an earlier date.

Usernames aren\'t saved in your recovery phrase, so pick yours again. Your old one is fine. It\'s how you appear to people who haven\'t saved you as a contact.
